drafts_today.topic: I'm at Sunnycrest today and tomorrow
drafts_today.text:
Sunshine Coast: I'm at Sunnycrest Mall in Gibsons today and tomorrow, 11 to 4.

Free self-applied facial, no purchase necessary.
Guess how many balls are in the tub. Closest guess wins at the end of each day.

Come say hi and tell me what winter is doing to your skin.
drafts_today.picture_tip: One straight-on phone photo of your table right now: the ball tub front and centre with a draw slip beside it, your Dermatology Booster EX, Serum EX and Dermatology Cream behind, Sunnycrest Radiance poster in the corner. Mall daylight, no flash.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-10 s vertical clip: start tight on the ball tub, give it a little shake, pull back to the whole table and end on you waving. On-screen text: 'Sunnycrest Mall, Gibsons. Sat + Sun 11-4.'

drafts_today.topic: The 3 spots winter hits first (Multi Stick Balm)
drafts_today.text:
Winter skin after 40 doesn't dry out evenly.

For me it's the same 3 spots:
1. Around the nose
2. Lips
3. The cheek that faces the car heater

I keep a RIMAN ICD Multi Stick Balm in my coat pocket for exactly those.

Where does winter hit you first?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Close-up of the Multi Stick Balm half out of your coat pocket (cozy knit or rain jacket), on the car seat or by the front door. Natural window light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8 s: hand pulls the balm from the coat pocket, uncaps it, glides it over the back of the hand (or a cheekbone). On-screen text: '3 spots winter hits first'. No voice needed.

drafts_today.topic: The only skincare tool I reach for (Radiansome 100 Concentrate)
drafts_today.text:
Everyone's buying skincare tools this season.

The only one I reach for comes on the bottle: the metal applicator on RIMAN's Radiansome 100 Concentrate.

A small amount, light strokes outward and upward:
- around the eyes
- along the neck

Then cream to seal. That's it.
drafts_today.picture_tip: The Radiansome 100 Concentrate standing on a bathroom shelf with the metal applicator tip toward the camera, the Toner, Essence and Cream softly blurred behind. Morning window light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-12 s vertical: dispense a little, glide the applicator outward under the eye, then upward along the neck, then a quick shot of the Radiansome Cream. On-screen text: 'outward + upward'. Only post if you have the Concentrate in your kit.
